Unlike many lag-clearing addons, Clear Lag BP requires no experimental features, no cheats, and no resource pack. All settings can be adjusted in-game using a user-friendly configuration menu, allowing server owners to customize cleanup behavior without editing files.

Features

- Automatic cleanup of dropped items

- Configurable countdown warnings before every cleanup

- Removes projectiles such as arrows, snowballs, tridents, potions, fishing hooks, and more

- Removes empty boats and unused minecarts

- Performance monitor with TPS estimate, entity count, and player count

- Achievement-friendly custom slash commands

- Live in-game configuration menu

- Item whitelist support, including custom addon items

- Custom projectile support for addon compatibility

- Multiplayer, Realms, and Bedrock Dedicated Server compatible

- Optimized cleanup using "system.runJob" to minimize lag spikes

Commands

- "/clearlag:status"

- "/clearlag:now"

- "/clearlag:pause"

- "/clearlag:resume"

- "/clearlag:reload"

- "/clearlag:config"

Compatibility

- Minecraft Bedrock Edition 1.26.31+

- Survival friendly

- Achievement friendly

- No experimental APIs

- No resource pack required

- Multiplayer compatible

- Realms compatible

- Bedrock Dedicated Server compatible

- Supports custom addon items and projectiles

Performance

Clear Lag BP is designed for efficiency. Cleanup tasks are spread across multiple ticks using "system.runJob", preventing large lag spikes and watchdog issues. Entity scans are scheduled only when necessary, ensuring consistent performance even on low-end devices and busy multiplayer servers.

Whether you're hosting a large survival server or playing in a single-player world, Clear Lag BP helps maintain stable performance without disrupting normal gameplay.
